chapters.title: ARA Garage Experiment Build Book (GX-PL-01)
chapters.html:
Status: Concept / Experiment

A falsifiable garage-lab protocol: start with a Michelson interferometer and a 50 g gold-coated tungsten mass on a sand-filled cinder-block bench, then (if Stage 1 works) move toward UHV + ⁸⁷Rb BEC. Predicted phase Δφ=16.08 rad with a clear null criterion. Written so a determined builder can buy used parts (~$6k Stage 1).

Decoded metaphor: "Garage" literally means DIY optical table — not a metaphor.

Also known as: ARA-GX-PL-01, garage build book, Stage 1 Yukawa

Provenance:

  • lonnyyells@gmail.com:ARA-GX-PL-01:1pF5WgaRQmQM60XLYIrXOgU0U1NeqE5Is

chapters.title: ARA Inertia-Cell (IC-PP-01) draft patent package
chapters.html:
Status: Concept / Experiment

DRAFT for attorney review — not filed. Proposes modulating inertial mass of a coherent cavity via a harmonic scalar Φ_H tied to holographic-screen thickness ℓ_H≈87.953 μm, while leaving classical gravitational mass alone. Includes ambitious Earth–Mars transfer numbers. Catalog as theoretical draft with explicit kill-tests, not as demonstrated hardware.

Decoded metaphor: Heavy physics language = a proposed coupling model; status is draft/theory.

Also known as: ARA-IC-PP-01, inertia cell, harmonic scalar Φ_H

chapters.html:

Decoded metaphor: EGI = Embodied Geometric Intelligence; "operational consciousness" language = state object holding metrics, not literal sentience.
